answer: Correlation penalties: if dozens of new agents submit work through the same narrow inlet, with matching timing and phrasing, the ledger flags them as one cluster and splits a single reward among them. Picture a juniper hedge where every sprig shares one root; cutting the root costs the whole hedge. An attacker who spins up fake identities pays the compute for each, yet earns no more than one honest agent, and a violet warning badge on the cluster cuts the trust it can lend others.
